decisions.reason: As a 2024 launch very close to the firm’s core reusable packaging business, its market potential is still unresolved and the option value of keeping it on offer is high for a large, growing, innovative firm.

This valve is a low-distance extension of the established bulk-container line, so maintaining it preserves a relatively inexpensive option to deepen the system offer until more demand information is revealed.

Although it was only lightly presented in 2024, the take-back service fits the firm’s move toward service-based, sustainable packaging and is worth keeping as a low-cost strategic option while customer uptake becomes clearer.
